analysis.headline: Software and Energy Lead Market Rotation Amid Mixed Horizon Signals Across Broad Indices
analysis.executive_summary: Quantitative ETF rotation analysis reveals focused leadership in Software (IGV) and US Energy (XLE), both maintaining confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER states and top cross-sectional scores. Geographic breadth shows strong short-term improvement in emerging country benchmarks such as Peru (EPU) and South Africa (EZA). Meanwhile, broad market indices like Nasdaq-100 (QQQ) display weakening confirmed trends alongside mixed-horizon relative strength, while Consumer Discretionary exhibits significant intra-sector divergence between broad retail and large-cap consumer components.

emerging_rotations.title: Peru Equity Rotation Emerging
emerging_rotations.explanation: EPU holds a confirmed EMERGING state with a rotation score of 90.00, ranking 1st in the ex-US country group. Quantitative metrics show a 5-bar score change of +14.88, a 20-bar score change of +11.59, 20-bar relative strength of +5.33 percentage points, and 63-bar relative strength of +9.70 percentage points. A pending raw state of PERSISTENT_LEADER is noted at 2 of 3 confirmation observations.

emerging_rotations.title: Oil Services Emerging Strength
emerging_rotations.explanation: OIH carries a confirmed EMERGING state with a rotation score of 70.19, ranking 5th in US industry themes following a 20-bar score improvement of +28.15 and a 5-bar score change of +10.74. Relative strength evidence across horizons is mixed, with 20-bar relative strength at +6.44 percentage points while 63-bar relative strength remains at -3.81 percentage points.

persistent_leaders.title: Software Reaches 63-Bar Score High
persistent_leaders.explanation: IGV maintains a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state with the highest cross-sectional rotation score in the dataset at 94.07, marking a 63-bar score high. Strength is confirmed by a 5-bar score change of +18.70, a 20-bar score change of +36.30, 20-bar relative strength of +14.26 percentage points, and 63-bar relative strength of +12.87 percentage points.

persistent_leaders.title: US Energy Maintains Sector Leadership
persistent_leaders.explanation: XLE holds a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state, ranking 1st among US sectors with a rotation score of 90.91. Evidence includes a 20-bar score improvement of +29.09, a 5-bar score change of +4.09, 20-bar relative strength of +1.68 percentage points, and 63-bar relative strength of +7.72 percentage points.

reaccelerating_rotations.title: New Zealand Reaccelerating Trend
reaccelerating_rotations.explanation: ENZL holds a confirmed REACCELERATING state with a rotation score of 69.63, reflecting a 5-bar score change of +9.15 after a 20-bar score decline of -1.71. Relative strength indicators show mixed horizons, with 20-bar relative strength at -0.67 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength at +2.35 percentage points. A pending raw state of NEUTRAL is noted at 1 of 3 observations.

weakening_rotations.title: Food & Beverage Deterioration
weakening_rotations.explanation: PBJ is in a confirmed WEAKENING state with a rotation score of 17.59, recording a 5-bar score change of -31.11 and a 20-bar score change of -30.19. Relative strength is negative on both horizons (-5.33 percentage points over 20 bars and -3.23 percentage points over 63 bars), while CMF20 shows extreme negative market participation at -0.706. A pending raw state of ROTATION_OUT is active at 2 of 3 confirmation observations.

weakening_rotations.title: Nasdaq-100 Confirmed Weakening Trend
weakening_rotations.explanation: QQQ holds a confirmed WEAKENING state with a score of 83.33. Relative strength metrics display divergent horizons, with 20-bar relative strength positive at +1.53 percentage points while 63-bar relative strength is negative at -4.31 percentage points. Short-term score improvement of +18.33 over 5 bars creates a pending raw state of EMERGING at 1 of 3 confirmation observations.

rotation_out.title: Utilities Confirmed Rotation-Out State
rotation_out.explanation: XLU exhibits a confirmed ROTATION_OUT state with the lowest score among US sectors at 15.91. Quantitative evidence shows a 5-bar score change of -1.82, a 20-bar score change of -23.64, 20-bar relative strength of -7.28 percentage points, and 63-bar relative strength of -5.08 percentage points.

geographic_rotations.title: South Africa Leads 20-Bar Improvements
geographic_rotations.explanation: EZA holds a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state with a rotation score of 81.04, recording a +52.99 20-bar score change (the highest 20-bar improvement across ex-US country ETFs) and a 5-bar score change of +13.29. Relative strength is positive across both horizons at +8.20 percentage points over 20 bars and +1.78 percentage points over 63 bars.

geographic_rotations.title: Turkey Reaches 63-Bar Score High
geographic_rotations.explanation: TUR carries a confirmed NEUTRAL state with a score of 78.78, marking a 63-bar score high. Quantitative indicators include a 20-bar score change of +47.68, a 5-bar score change of +29.88, 20-bar relative strength of +4.03 percentage points, and 63-bar relative strength of +3.41 percentage points. A pending raw state of PERSISTENT_LEADER is present at 1 of 3 confirmation observations.

pair_relationships.title: Large-Cap Value vs Growth Mixed Pair Signal
pair_relationships.explanation: IWD is paired directly against paired_ticker IWF in a Value vs Growth relationship. IWD lags IWF over a 20-bar horizon with a pair spread of -2.76 percentage points, but leads IWF over a 63-bar horizon with a pair spread of +11.01 percentage points. Relative strength evidence for IWD reflects split horizons with 20-bar relative strength at -2.76 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength at +11.01 percentage points.

pair_relationships.title: Equal Weight vs Cap Weight Divergence
pair_relationships.explanation: RSP is paired directly against paired_ticker SPY in an Equal Weight vs Cap Weight comparison. RSP lags SPY over 20 bars with a pair spread of -1.15 percentage points, but leads SPY over 63 bars with a pair spread of +4.30 percentage points. Relative strength metrics for RSP reflect split horizons with 20-bar relative strength at -1.15 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength at +4.30 percentage points.

cross_market_confirmations: US Energy sector strength in XLE (confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER, score 90.91) is confirmed by domestic oil services OIH (confirmed EMERGING, score 70.19, 20-bar score change +28.15) and global energy benchmark IXC (score 81.00).

Technology sector momentum is confirmed across sub-industries, with Software IGV (confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER, score 94.07, 63-bar score high) and Cloud Computing SKYY (confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER, score 92.22) occupying the top cross-sectional positions.
risks_or_conflicts: A material sector divergence exists in Consumer Discretionary, where improver XLY records a +16.36 20-bar score change while deteriorator XRT suffers a -48.15 20-bar score change (a 64.51 point divergence), alongside secondary weakness in homebuilders XHB (score 34.81).

Horizon divergence is evident in major market indices such as QQQ (20-bar relative strength +1.53 percentage points vs 63-bar relative strength -4.31 percentage points) and style pairs such as IWF (20-bar relative strength +2.76 percentage points vs 63-bar relative strength -11.01 percentage points).
analysis.methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
